summary:
V14 — Share Makeover + Favourite Version + Reel Auto-Play + Sandbox Notes. ALL green on backend and frontend.

BACKEND (10/10 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_v14_features.py):
- POST /api/projects/{id}/designs/{did}/favourite: 401 unauth ✓; 404 unknown project ✓; 404 unknown design ✓; 404 non-owner (owner-only) ✓; toggle True→GET verifies designs[].favourite=True, toggle False→GET verifies designs[].favourite=False ✓; response {ok:true, favourite:<bool>} ✓.
- POST /api/projects/{id}/share-image: 401 unauth ✓; 404 unknown project ✓; 400 when project has no original_path ✓; 404 unknown design ✓; happy path returns {image_path:'glamgarden/shares/<uid>/<hex>.png'}, GET /api/files/{path} requires auth (401 unauth) and serves valid PNG with content-type image/png, 89 50 4E 47 magic bytes, size > 5KB, Pillow parses it as landscape composition (width>height) confirming BEFORE|AFTER layout ✓.
- Both endpoints use owner-scoped Mongo update ({owner_id, id, designs.id}) so cross-user access returns 404 (not 403) — consistent with existing style.

FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, real Gemini backing data):
Setup: seeded fresh customer TEST_v14fe_70114@example.com via API — uploaded a JPG, created project proj_d7511bb5cf00, ran two real Gemini redesigns (~20s each) producing v1 + v2. (ImagePicker native dialog isn't drivable in Playwright web, per agent-to-agent note.)

(1) FAVOURITE + REEL ORDER — reel-Before/reel-v1/reel-v2 all render as reelDesigns thumbs. Initial order: ['reel-Before','reel-v1','reel-v2'] (creation order, latest last). After tapping favourite-toggle (current=v2 latest), order becomes ['reel-Before','reel-v2','reel-v1'] i.e. favourited design pinned to FRONT of reel. Screenshot confirms yellow ⭐ badge on v2 thumbnail and 'Pinned to the top of your reel ⭐' success toast. Version labels stay tied to creation order (still 'v1'/'v2', not renumbered) — matches spec.

(2) PLAY REEL — play-reel button toggles Play→Stop; interval steps original→v1→v2 with the Animated.Value fade (0.3→1 over 480ms). After ds.length+1 ticks it auto-stops back to 'Play'. Verified button text transitions and no crash.

(3) COMPARE + SHARE — open-compare opens CompareModal with 'vs Original' segment; Share button (compare-share) shows spinner then triggers navigator.share fallback → anchor download of 'garden-makeover.png' (captured via page.on('download')) and success toast 'Image downloaded — share it anywhere 📤'. compare-close closes the modal cleanly. No error toast, no crash.

(4) ADMIN SANDBOX NOTES — admin login → /admin/sandbox → save-preset opens modal exposing preset-name-input AND preset-note-input; entering name 'TESTv14a' + note 'test note v14' + preset-save-confirm creates a chip whose inner text shows the name AND note underneath (screenshot confirms two-line chip). Tapping preset-TESTv14a re-applies filters (toast 'Recipe "TESTv14a" loaded'); preset-del-TESTv14a removes it (count → 0). Presets remain client-side (AsyncStorage), matches spec.

Console warnings observed (carried over, cosmetic): 'shadow*' → boxShadow deprecation and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns repeatedly on web preview: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking cosmetic. Carried over from prior iterations.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' when modals open. Non-blocking cosmetic.

action_items: Optional cleanup (carried over): sweep remaining shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings on RN Web to silence dev console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_projects.favourite_design correctly checks matched_count==0 to 404 both 'wrong project' AND 'wrong design_id in existing project' cases (Mongo positional operator only matches when designs.id is present). Owner-scoped filter means cross-user access also 404s — safe.

routes_projects.share_image: uses run_in_threadpool for get_object/put_object/compose_before_after — good, keeps Pillow off the event loop. Records the generated share PNG into db.uploads with {share:true} so GET /api/files/{path} can auth-serve it. Path scheme glamgarden/shares/<user_id>/<hex>.png is user-scoped, no path traversal risk.

compose_before_after: resizes both inputs to a common H=900 preserving aspect, PIL-fallback fonts (DejaVuSans) are present on the container. BEFORE/AFTER pills + footer look correct in the generated PNG we round-tripped.

project/[id].tsx toggleFavourite: performs an OPTIMISTIC update on both `project.designs` AND `current` state (crucial so the star icon on favourite-toggle button also flips immediately), then persists. If the network call fails it shows a toast but does NOT rollback — small risk of client/server drift on flaky network; consider revert on error. Non-blocking.

reelDesigns sort keys favourite first then creation order (stable via orderIndex Map) — matches spec exactly. Labels 'v${orderIndex+1}' remain tied to creation order regardless of favourite pinning — verified in UI (v2 shows first but still labelled 'v2').
playReel uses setInterval with playRef.current cleanup on unmount — safe; index i==0 shows Before, i>=1 shows designs[i-1]. Auto-stops on idx>ds.length.

CompareModal.tsx: share button (compare-share) is disabled while sharing (spinner replaces label). Web share fallback prefers navigator.canShare({files:[File]}) then falls back to anchor download — appropriate for web preview where nav.share may not accept Files.

admin/sandbox.tsx preset object schema is {id,name,note?,filters} — chip renders note in a secondary Text (presetChipNote style) only when p.note truthy. Save preset only enabled when presetName.trim() is non-empty — good UX guard.
core.py still 868 lines (>700 guideline) — non-blocking, carried over from V13.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all four V14 flows (favourite reel-reorder + play-reel + compare-share + admin sandbox preset note)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest module creates two fresh @example.com customers per session (TEST_v14_* owner and TEST_v14b_* other), one project WITH original photo (proj_...) that runs one real Gemini redesign, one empty project (no photo) for the 400 test. Frontend seed via /tmp/seed_fe.py: fresh customer TEST_v14fe_70114@example.com with project proj_d7511bb5cf00 containing 2 real Gemini designs. All test data is @example.com and will be swept by admin 'Clean demo data' tool.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V14 endpoints live in routes_projects.py: favourite_design + share_image + compose_before_after (Pillow BEFORE|AFTER composer). The share PNG is served through /api/files/{path} which REQUIRES auth (401 unauth, 200 with Bearer). When testing the compare-share button in web preview, register a `page.on('download', ...)` handler BEFORE clicking — the fallback path in shareMakeover creates an anchor + .click() which Playwright surfaces as a download event; the success toast is 'Image downloaded — share it anywhere 📤'. Presets remain AsyncStorage-only (client-side); the preset-note-input is inside a Modal (saveOpen state) so navigator-driven native dialogs are NOT involved. Reel labels are decoupled from favourite order — verify BOTH: (a) reel DOM order (favourites first) via data-testid enumeration and (b) label persistence (v1 stays v1). ImagePicker native dialog still can't be driven from Playwright; seed projects via API as done here.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All four V14 features (Share Makeover with branded PNG, Favourite pinning + star badge + reel reorder, Reel auto-play, Sandbox preset notes) verified working end-to-end on backend and mobile web preview.
